title: Seaside Neighborhood School
subtitle: Washington, D.C. October 15-18, 2026
bodyHtml:
Families, you are currently viewing a sample itinerary customized for Seaside Neighborhood School. Please note that this version is meant to provide a general overview of the experiences and activities the trip organizers hope to include. As we get closer to departure, the school or designated trip organizer will share the most up-to-date and finalized itinerary, reflecting any adjustments, confirmed reservations, and timing updates. For now, please enjoy this preview of what is planned for your student’s upcoming trip.

Day 1: Travel to Washington, D.C. & National Museum of American History

  • Travel to Washington, D.C.!
  • Lunch Allocation
  • Visit the National Museum of American History
  • Visit the National Portrait Gallery
  • Group sit-down dinner
  • Visit the Lincoln Memorial, Vietnam, and Korean War Memorials, World War II Memorial, and Washington Monument
  • Check-in to Hotel Accommodations with Overnight Security (three nights)
 

Day 2: United States Capitol Building Tour & National Archives

  • Breakfast at the hotel
  • Visit the United States Capitol 
  • Visit the Library of Congress
  • Lunch Allocation
  • Visit the Supreme Court Building Exhibit
  • Visit the National Archives
  • Dinner and Games at Level 99
  • Visit the US Marine Corps War Memorial: Iwo Jima
  • Return to Hotel Accommodations 
 

Day 3: Arlington National Cemetery & Guided Ghost Tour of Alexandria 

  • Breakfast at the hotel
  • Landmark Leader Led Walking Tour of Arlington National Cemetery
  • Visit the Smithsonian Museum of Natural History
  • Lunch Allocation 
  • Visit The People’s House
  • White House Photo Opportunity Stop from Lafayette Park/Pennsylvania Avenue 
  • Group sit-down dinner in Old Town Alexandria 
  • Guided Ghost Tour of Alexandria 
  • Return to Hotel Accommodations

Day 4: United States Holocaust Memorial Museum & Depart for Home

  • Breakfast at the hotel
  • Visit the United States Holocaust Memorial Museum
  • Lunch Allocation
  • Visit Ford’s Theater, Petersen House, and Aftermath Exhibits 
  • Dinner Allocation
  • Departure for Home
